title: University of Michigan consumer sentiment — final (Dec 2026), the revision of the first all-post-election prelim and the last survey read before year-end
source: EST: the publisher's own `2026 Release Dates` document, data.sca.isr.umich.edu/fetchdoc.php?docid=79628 (HTTP 200, 132,710 bytes, PDF text layer inflated direct 2026-11-05 by umich-sentiment-prelim-2026-12-04's initial research), whose text lists verbatim "December 18 / December Final" after "December 4 / December Prelim", with its own caveat "November and December are a bit off this schedule due to holidays". Corroborated by `2026 Interview Dates`, fetchdoc.php?docid=79629 (HTTP 200, 89,846 bytes, same session), whose December row reads "December 14 IW Ends", i.e. the final's window closes the Monday before the Friday release. Filed `estimate` on this lane's no-self-confirm limit only; the UMICH: prefix exists and this event's own never-assessed lane can promote it off the same two documents. No clock time is in either document; the publisher's results page states only the NEXT release's slot, so 10:00 ET for 12-18 is customary, not sourced. The date is read from the first fetch, not re-fetched 2026-11-26
notes: PROPOSED 2026-11-26 by umich-sentiment-prelim-2026-12-04's D-8 pulse, the first pulse at which the final sits inside the horizon leash (D-22 of 60 days; allImpactsWithinDays 30). Earlier rows named it beyond the leash (D-43 on 11-05, 35 days on 11-13) and correctly did not file it. Why it is material: a final is defined as a revision of its prelim, so 12-04 is the baseline it is measured against, and the pair is the only place the all-post-election window (11-17 -> 11-30, prelim) and its extension (through 12-14) can be read together; the 11-20 final's own revision was +0.5 (51.0 -> 51.5) and year-ahead inflation expectations fell 4.3% -> 3.7% in the final. It lands the same Friday as opex-2026-12-18 (triple witching, high) and boj-decision-2026-12-18, nine days after fomc-2026-12-09, so its 10:00 ET tape cannot be attributed to the survey. Impact `medium` matches the other 2026 UMich entries; the tier is a proposer's judgment for the owning lane to revisit. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, `estimate` date, no house playbook is macro-keyed.
